subject: Re: 🔵{Brand} & MobUpps
body:
Hi RECIPIENT_NAME,
Last note from me on the cost-per-sale program for {Brand}, after my earlier emails on return-adjusted payout and incremental web sales. If the timing is not right, I will leave it here and step back. Either way, you have the context for when it becomes useful.
register_notes: Stage 3 EN ecommerce CPS: references original email + earlier stages (return-adjusted payout, incremental sales); direct close with easy out (releases prospect if timing wrong); no MobUpps figure; native American-English register; 0 question marks; no sign-off; no 'X, not Y'.
